title: vercel-config.json
description: Per-app Vercel deploy config consumed by the deploy-web-apps workflow. The app root is the directory containing this file. The workflow builds the app with `vercel build` from the repo root, using the Vercel project's own build settings (build command, output directory, env vars).

projectName.description: Name of the Vercel project. Only used in logs, since it often differs from the Nx project name.

projectId.description: ID of the Vercel project (Project Settings -> General, or `vercel project inspect <name>`).
